productOnPage.description: Yoto Says: Discover a joyful journey of timeless children's music, celebrating cultures and creativity around the world! Take a trip around the world of sound with Smithsonian Folkways! Since its founding in 1948, Folkways has placed music by and for children at the heart of its mission to support cultural diversity and increase understanding among peoples.That’s why in this card pack we’re sharing definitive folk music classics from the USA, eclectic masterworks by Black folk musicians from the United States and the Caribbean, and essential children’s music from across Latin America, performed by some of the most important folk musicians of the twentieth and twenty-first centuries.These rich collections invite listeners of all ages to sing and dance and play and hear together, while opening children's ears to the sounds of Woody Guthrie, Lead Belly, Ella Jenkins, Suni Paz, and more. Each card is a fun, friendly entryway into a universe of music for folk music lovers young, old, and everything in between. Tracks included: This Land is Your Land - Woody Guthrie Freight Train - Elizabeth Cotten Big Rock Candy Mountain - Haywire Mac If I Had a Hammer - Pete Seeger The Midnight Special - Lead Belly Shady Grove - Jean Ritchie Frog Went Courting - Sam Hinton You'll Sing a Song and I'll Sing a Song - Ella Jenkins Whoopie Ti Yi Yo, Get Along Little Dogies - Cisco Houston Little Bird, Little Bird - Elizabeth Mitchell

productOnPage.descriptionMarkdown:
**_Yoto Says: Discover a joyful journey of timeless children's music, celebrating cultures and creativity around the world!._**

Take a trip around the world of sound with Smithsonian Folkways! Since its founding in 1948, Folkways has placed music by and for children at the heart of its mission to support cultural diversity and increase understanding among peoples.  
  
  
  
  
That’s why in this card pack we’re sharing definitive folk music classics from the USA, eclectic masterworks by Black folk musicians from the United States and the Caribbean, and essential children’s music from across Latin America, performed by some of the most important folk musicians of the twentieth and twenty-first centuries.  
  
  
  
  
These rich collections invite listeners of all ages to sing and dance and play and hear together, while opening children's ears to the sounds of Woody Guthrie, Lead Belly, Ella Jenkins, Suni Paz, and more. Each card is a fun, friendly entryway into a universe of music for folk music lovers young, old, and everything in between.

Tracks included:

*   This Land is Your Land - Woody Guthrie
*   Freight Train - Elizabeth Cotten
*   Big Rock Candy Mountain - Haywire Mac
*   If I Had a Hammer - Pete Seeger
*   The Midnight Special - Lead Belly
*   Shady Grove - Jean Ritchie
*   Frog Went Courting - Sam Hinton
*   You'll Sing a Song and I'll Sing a Song - Ella Jenkins
*   Whoopie Ti Yi Yo, Get Along Little Dogies - Cisco Houston
*   Little Bird, Little Bird - Elizabeth Mitchell

#### Who are Creators on Yoto?

Creators are independent audio makers bringing their original stories, games, songs and more to Yoto Cards. We hand-pick the best and freshest ideas — so every Creators Card meets the Yoto gold standard.

[Explore the Creators Collection](/creators/)

[Read Creator biographies](https://yoto.space/creator-profiles)
